source: Measured natively, outside the engine, and to be re-measured through `ale validate` before the task is submitted: the reference controller (solution/reference: privileged tips in place of perception, rate commands through the public wire) played the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps, generator endosim-procedure/0.2) through tests/verify.py's own loop (tests/review/run_native.py: the same sessions, probes, budgets, renderer and canary; the controller and the renderer started as the calling account instead of through runuser), Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 rendering on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada (not a cloud-listed GPU model), driver 570.195.03, no Docker, on 2026-11-24. Three full runs gave useful_view_fraction 0.9034375 each (8673 of 9600 steps; per procedure 0.939 0.865 0.953 0.926 0.878 0.914 0.838 0.934 0.875 0.928 0.926 0.868), probes 570/570, 578/578 and 534/534, no aborted procedure, no lens contact; in the third run the renderer lost the GPU once and was restarted by the grader without a change in the number. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer: the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py) gives the same 0.9034 (hidden/selection.json). full_at 0.98: the runs repeat exactly; the margin covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Status and what was not verified: tests/README.md section 7.
